# quay_organization_robot_federation (Data Source)

Reads the OIDC federation configuration for an organization robot account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quay_organization" "org" {
  name  = "org"
  email = "quay+org@example.com"
}

data "quay_organization_robot_federation" "ci" {
  orgname   = quay_organization.org.name
  robotname = "ci"
}

output "robot_federation" {
  value = data.quay_organization_robot_federation.ci.federation
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `orgname` (String) The name of the organization that owns the robot.
- `robotname` (String) The short name of the robot (without the organization prefix).

### Read-Only

- `federation` (Attributes List) The list of OIDC federation rules configured for the robot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--federation))

<a id="nestedatt--federation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `federation`

Read-Only:

- `issuer` (String) The issuer (`iss` claim) of the OIDC token.
- `subject` (String) The subject (`sub` claim) of the OIDC token.
